title: Isandro and the Prom
author: Edmund Eastwick
blurb: Coral Dunmore, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
